literal: Even in the condition of support being lost, cherishing old relationships exists only with kinsmen.
translation: Even when one's wealth and support are entirely lost, the quality of cherishing old relationships is found only among one's kinsmen.
modern: ஆதரவு அல்லது செல்வம் இல்லாத வறுமை நிலையிலும், பழைய உறவைப் போற்றிப் பாராட்டும் குணம் சுற்றத்தாரிடமே உண்டு.
explanation: This couplet highlights the unique value of relatives during times of adversity. The word 'paṟṟu' here refers to wealth or support, and 'aṟṟa kaṇṇum' means 'even when that support is completely lost'. While others might abandon a person who has lost their fortune, true kinsmen will still cherish and honor their long-standing relationship ('paḻaimai pārāṭṭutal'). This enduring loyalty is a defining characteristic found only ('kaṇṇē') among one's relatives.
